versions.changelog: Explain API key setup and first run, with safe task follow-up.

Initial release of Hailuo AI Video generation via AceDataCloud API.

- Generate AI videos from text or animate a still image into a video
- Supports three models: text-to-video, image-to-video, and image-to-video with director mode for precise control
- Requires ACEDATACLOUD_API_TOKEN for authentication
- Simple API: specify action, prompt, model, and (for i2v) source image URL
- Added guidance on supported parameters, workflows, and polling for video generation status
